name: Crowley Cincinnati Office - Cincinnati OH
type: Logistics office (downtown high-rise, no truck yard)

fieldNotes.siteIdentification: The only Crowley presence in the Cincinnati area listed on crowley.com/locations is an OFFICE at 312 Plum Street, Suite 1430, Cincinnati OH 45202 (phone 513-407-5050). Geocoded ROOFTOP to a full-block downtown high-rise office building (Suite 1430 = 14th floor). Satellite z18-z20 and Street View confirm a multi-story downtown office tower with a central light well, flanked by other office towers and the I-71/Fort Washington Way freeway - NO truck yard, no docks, no drop area of any kind.
fieldNotes.noYard: This is a white-collar sales/logistics office, not an operational yard facility. There is nothing to audit for yard-management purposes: dockDoorCount=0, trailerParkingCapacity=0, no truck gate. A nearby 'Crowley's' at 8957 Cincinnati-Columbus Rd, West Chester OH is an UNRELATED commercial printer, not a Crowley Maritime/Logistics warehouse - so there is no Crowley truck yard in the Cincinnati metro to substitute.
fieldNotes.yardSpotsMeaning: N/A - no trailer parking or container slots exist at this office address.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~0.7 ac is the office building's downtown block footprint, not a yard - reported only for completeness.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Exclude from per-site yard pricing / yard-management TAM. Carry as an office node only. If Crowley runs an actual Cincinnati-area DC under a 3PL/partner address, it is not published on crowley.com and was not findable.
